name: 39232 · Flowood, MS
findings: ZIP 39232 (Flowood) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39232 (Flowood) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
65% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 39232 (Flowood) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 68% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
